content-label: Accessible name of the page's text editor.
placeholder: Placeholder of an empty page's text. "/" is the key that opens the block menu; keep it.
paste-refused: Notice when a paste held pictures or embedded content. Markdown is a format's name.
link-prompt: The browser's prompt for a link's address. Keep "https://".
link-invalid: Notice for a link address that isn't allowed. Keep "http(s)".
hint: Tip under the editor. <kbd> wraps the "/" key; keep the tags and the key. "⌘/Ctrl + S" is the save shortcut.
toolbar.label: Accessible name of the formatting toolbar.
toolbar.bold: Button (an icon) on the page editor's formatting toolbar that makes the selected text bold.
toolbar.italic: Toolbar button (an icon) that makes the selected text italic.
toolbar.bullet-list: Toolbar button (an icon) that turns the text into a bulleted list.
toolbar.numbered-list: Toolbar button (an icon) that turns the text into a numbered list.
toolbar.quote: Toolbar button (an icon) that turns the text into a quotation block.
toolbar.code-block: Toolbar button (an icon) that turns the text into a block of program code.
toolbar.link: Toolbar button that adds a link to the selected text.
toolbar.undo: Toolbar button (an icon) that undoes the last edit.
toolbar.redo: Toolbar button (an icon) that redoes the edit just undone.
slash.heading: Heading of the menu of blocks that "/" opens; shown in capitals.
slash.label: Accessible name of that menu.
slash.empty: In that menu when no block matches what was typed after "/".
blocks.text.title: Block in the "/" menu: a paragraph. The menu searches titles and descriptions.
blocks.text.description: Under the block's title in the "/" menu: what the block is.
blocks.heading-1.title: Block in the "/" menu: the largest heading level.
blocks.heading-1.description: Under the block's title in the "/" menu.
blocks.heading-2.title: Block in the "/" menu: the middle heading level.
blocks.heading-2.description: Under the block's title in the "/" menu.
blocks.heading-3.title: Block in the "/" menu: the smallest heading level.
blocks.heading-3.description: Under the block's title in the "/" menu.
blocks.bullet-list.title: Block in the "/" menu: a list with bullets.
blocks.bullet-list.description: Under the block's title in the "/" menu.
blocks.numbered-list.title: Block in the "/" menu: a list with numbers.
blocks.numbered-list.description: Under the block's title in the "/" menu.
blocks.checklist.title: Block in the "/" menu: a list of items with checkboxes.
blocks.checklist.description: Under the block's title in the "/" menu.
blocks.quote.title: Block in the "/" menu: a quotation (a noun).
blocks.quote.description: Under the block's title in the "/" menu.
blocks.code.title: Block in the "/" menu: a block of program code.
blocks.code.description: Under the block's title in the "/" menu.
blocks.divider.title: Block in the "/" menu: a horizontal line between sections.
blocks.divider.description: Under the block's title in the "/" menu.
blocks.table.title: Block in the "/" menu: a table.
blocks.table.description: Under the block's title in the "/" menu: the new table starts with three columns and a header row.
blocks.dataset-view.title: Block in the "/" menu: a live table or chart of a dataset (product feature).
blocks.dataset-view.description: Under the block's title in the "/" menu.
view.title: Default heading of a dataset view block (a live table or chart of a dataset).
view.rows: How many rows the view shows. {{count}} is the number.
view.rows-more: How many rows the view shows when there are more than it shows. {{count}} is the number shown.
view.as-of: When the view's data was read. {{at}} is a time of day.
view.show-chart: Button (an icon) on a dataset view block shown as a table; it switches back to the chart.
view.show-table: Button (an icon) on a dataset view block shown as a chart; it shows the same data as a table.
view.refresh: Accessible name of the button (an icon) that reads the view's data again.
view.edit: Button (an icon) on a dataset view block that opens its settings (dataset, query, display).
view.loading: Shown in a dataset view block (a live table or chart in a page) while its data loads.
view.private: Note under a view only its owner can see. <link> wraps the link to the dataset's page; keep the tags.
view.displays.table: How the view shows its data: a table.
view.displays.bar: How the view shows its data: a bar chart.
view.displays.line: How the view shows its data: a line chart.
view.refresh-every.seconds: Auto-refresh choice. {{count}} is a number of seconds.
view.refresh-every.minutes: Auto-refresh choice. {{count}} is a number of minutes.
view.refresh-every.hours: Auto-refresh choice. {{count}} is a number of hours.
view.form.label: Accessible name of the settings form of a dataset view block.
view.form.dataset: Label of the picker of the dataset the view reads.
view.form.choose: First choice in the dataset picker, before one is chosen.
view.form.loading: In the dataset picker while the list of datasets loads.
view.form.shared-here: A dataset in the picker that the person shared with this Space. {{name}} is its name.
view.form.shared-by: A dataset in the picker that someone else shared. {{name}} is its name, {{owner}} its owner's name.
view.form.another-user: Stands in for {{owner}} when the owner's name is unknown.
view.form.unknown: The picker's choice for a dataset the person can't open.
view.form.display: Label of the picker of how the view shows its data (table, bar chart, line chart).
view.form.x: Label of the column the chart's horizontal axis uses.
view.form.values: Label of the column the chart plots.
view.form.first-column: Default for the horizontal axis: the first column.
view.form.first-numbers: Default for the values: the first column with numbers.
view.form.title: Label of the field with the view's heading.
view.form.title-label: Accessible name of the field with the view's heading.
view.form.title-placeholder: Placeholder of the view's title field: by default, the title is the dataset's name.
view.form.auto-refresh: Label of the picker of how often the view reads its data again by itself.
view.form.query: Label of the box with the view's SQL query.
view.form.query-label: Accessible name of the box with the view's SQL query.
view.form.query-placeholder: An example SQL query. Keep SELECT, FROM and ORDER BY; the names may be translated.
view.form.rule: Under the query: only one read-only SELECT (SQL) query is allowed.
view.form.run: Button that runs the query and previews the result, without saving.
view.form.save: Button that saves the view's settings.
view.form.cancel: Button that closes the view's settings without saving.
view.form.remove: Button that removes the dataset view block from the page.
embed.broken: In place of a link card (a block showing a web link's preview) that can't be read.
embed.label: Accessible name of a link card. {{site}} is the website's name.
embed.label-titled: Accessible name of a link card. {{site}} is the website's name, {{title}} the post's title.
embed.image-missing: In place of a link card's picture that is no longer available.
embed.image-missing-alt: In place of a picture that's gone. {{alt}} is the picture's description.
embed.video-missing: In place of a link card's video poster that is no longer available.
embed.video-missing-alt: In place of a video's poster that's gone. {{alt}} is its description.
embed.play: Accessible name of a video's link. {{site}} is the website's name.
embed.open: Link to the post on its website. {{host}} is the website's address (example.com).
embed.new-tab: Read by screen readers after a link; keep the parentheses.
image.missing: In place of a picture on the page that is no longer available.
image.missing-alt: In place of a picture that's gone. {{alt}} is the picture's description.
